article_manifest.title: Algeria: Why Parliament voted to send military units to Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Algérie: pourquoi le Parlement a voté pour l'envoi d'unités militaires au Niger
article_manifest.summary: Algeria: why the Parliament voted to send military units to Niger The Algerian Parliament approved Sunday, October 25, the sending of troops to Niger to protect energy facilities that Algeria financed, paving the way for the first official deployment of Algerian troops abroad since the 1973 Arab-Israeli War. Algerian-Nigerian cooperation goes up a notch After economic agreements, the two countries recently signed a military cooperation treaty.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Cooperation: Accra and Bamako consolidate their strategic and economic partnership
article_manifest.original_title: Coopération : Accra et Bamako consolident leur partenariat stratégique et économique
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, October 27 (AMAP) Ghana's new ambassador to Mali, Lieutenant-Colonel Umar Sanda Ahmed, who was received in audience on Monday by the Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, placed his mission under the sign of security cooperation, the opening up of Mali via Ghanaian ports and respect for the sovereignty and principles of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES), noted AMAP The Ghanaian diplomat reaffirmed his country's commitment to regional security as well as its firm commitment alongside Mali in the fight against insecurity and violent extremism .

article_manifest.title: Niger accuses Chad and France after drone strike on its territory
article_manifest.original_title: Le Niger accuse le Tchad et la France après une frappe de drone sur son territoire
article_manifest.summary: For some time now, relations between Niger and Chad have been experiencing friction and this is not about to be resolved in the immediate future. Indeed, relations between Niamey and N 'djamena are experiencing new tensions after a drone strike that the Nigerien authorities attribute to Chad in collaboration with France . The Nigerien authorities claim that the strike claimed the lives of two civilians and left several injured.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Niamey accuses Chad of a deadly drone strike with the support of France
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : Niamey accuse le Tchad d’une frappe de drone meurtrière avec l’appui de la France
article_manifest.summary: The Nigerien government has accused Chad of having carried out, with the support of France, a drone strike on its territory that killed two people and injured several civilians, according to an official statement in which Niamey announces the referral to the United Nations and the African Union. According to the Nigerien authorities, the attack occurred on October 24, around 01:00, in the Emiloulou area, in the Agadez region (north) .

article_manifest.title: Niger: Niamey accuses N’Djamena, in complicity with France, of"hostile acts"
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : Niamey accuse N’Djamena, en complicité avec la France, d’« actes hostiles »
article_manifest.summary: In a statement read on public television on the evening of Monday, October 26, the government informed national and international opinion that, on October 24 at around 1 a.m., the national territory was the target of a drone airstrike carried out from the territory of Chad, towards the Emilulu area, in the Agadez region, with the support of a foreign power, France .

article_manifest.title: Menaka: CNDH condemns attacks on civilians in Tagadayat
article_manifest.original_title: Ménaka : la CNDH condamne les attaques contre des civils à Tagadayat
article_manifest.summary: The National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) has condemned attacks on civilian populations in a camp in Tagadayat, in the Menaka region. In a statement, she said she is deeply concerned about these serious human rights violations, offers her condolences to the families of the victims and wishes a speedy recovery to the injured . The CNDH calls on the authorities to search for and bring to justice the perpetrators, sponsors and accomplices of these attacks.

article_manifest.title: The CNDH condemns the killings in Menaka and calls for investigations
article_manifest.original_title: La CNDH condamne les tueries à Ménaka et réclame des enquêtes
article_manifest.summary: Nearly 60 bodies were discovered in a mass grave at a camp near Menaka. The information was announced last Friday by the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), after attacks on several camps around the city. According to local sources, a massacre of civilians of such magnitude had not been reported in the region since 2020 .

article_manifest.title: Algeria To Deploy Troops To Niger In First Foreign Mission In 53 Years
article_manifest.original_title: Algeria To Deploy Troops To Niger In First Foreign Mission In 53 Years
article_manifest.summary: By Enyichukwu Enemanna Algeria is to send troops to Niger in its first foreign deployment since sending forces to Egypt during the Arab-Israeli war in 1973. The deployment follows a visit to Algiers by Niger’s defence minister, as the country seeks support against armed groups, some of which are linked to al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Algeria has economic interests in Niger, including a planned gas pipeline that would carry Nigerian gas through Niger to Algeria.

article_manifest.title: Algeria-Niger: a first Algerian military deployment abroad
article_manifest.original_title: Algérie-Niger : un premier déploiement militaire algérien à l'étranger
article_manifest.summary: Pour la première fois de son histoire, l'Algérie s'apprête à déployer des troupes hors de ses frontières. Le Parlement algérien a approuvé l'envoi de militaires au Niger, pays voisin confronté à une insécurité persistante due aux attaques de groupes djihadistes et à l'instabilité dans plusieurs régions du nord. Cette décision marque un tournant majeur dans la doctrine de défense algérienne et ouvre un nouveau chapitre dans les relations entre Alger et Niamey.

article_manifest.title: Homeland security: 120 4×4 pickups and 100 motorcycles handed over to security forces
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurité intérieure : 120 pick-up 4×4 et 100 motos remis aux forces de sécurité

Acquired from the State's own funds, this equipment aims to strengthen the operational capacities of the security forces in their missions of protecting people and property and defending territorial integrity .

article_manifest.summary: - التعاون العسكري بين الجزائر والنيجر: القرار جاء بعد توقيع اتفاق عسكري مشترك، وصوت البرلمان الجزائري لصالحه، مما يعكس مرحلة جديدة من التعاون الأمني والدفاعي لتأمين المشاريع المشتركة في ظل التهديدات الأمنية. - الجانب العملياتي والترتيبات اللوجيستية: القرار فتح الباب للترتيبات العملياتية واللوجيستية مع النيجر، بما في ذلك تحديد منطقة تمركز الوحدات، ويمثل أول إرسال لقوات جزائرية إلى الخارج منذ الاستقلال.

article_manifest.original_title: "جيل جديد" يعلّق على إرسال وحدات من الجيش إلى النيجر.. ما موقفه؟
article_manifest.summary: 26 أكتوبر 2026دعا حزب "جيل جديد" إلى ضبط أهداف ومجال مهمة وحدات من الجيش الوطني الشعبي في النيجر، وتحديد مدتها وشروط إنهائها بوضوح، مؤكدة أن حماية المصالح الاستراتيجية والطاقوية للجزائر لا ينبغي أن تقود إلى انخراط عسكري مفتوح خارج الحدود. وجاء موقف الحركة في بيان صدر عقب مصادقة غرفتي البرلمان، المجلس الشعبي الوطني ومجلس الأمة، يوم الأحد (أمس)، على قرار إرسال وحدات من الجيش الوطني الشعبي إلى النيجر، قبل أن تصدر رئاسة الجمهورية بيانًا بشأن القرار اليوم الاثنين.

article_manifest.title: Agadez/Security: In Bilma, Brigadier General Ibroh Amadou Bacharou reaffirms the CNSP's commitment to ensuring security in Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez/Sécurité : A Bilma, le Général de Brigade Ibroh Amadou Bacharou réaffirme l’engagement du CNSP à assurer la sécurité au Niger
article_manifest.summary: Brigadier General Ibro Amadou Bacharou, Special Chief of Staff of the President of the Republic, accompanied by Brigadier General Abdourahamane Abou Zataka, Chief of Staff of the Army, and several civilian and military personalities, carried out, on Friday, October 23, 2026, a working mission to Dirkou, in the department of Bilma, Agadez region . This visit was marked by a collective prayer and a large popular meeting during which the administrative authorities and representatives of the populations expressed their concerns and reaffirmed their commitment to peace, security and the rebuilding of Niger .

article_manifest.title: Tillabéri/Infrastructure: Minister Salissou Mahaman Salissou assesses the work of the Farié-Téra road and the impact of the Garbougna structure
article_manifest.original_title: Tillabéri/Infrastructures : Le ministre Salissou Mahaman Salissou évalue les travaux de la route Farié-Téra et l’impact de l’ouvrage de Garbougna
article_manifest.summary: The Minister of Equipment and Infrastructure, Colonel-Major Salissou Mahaman Salissou, made a visit on Friday, October 23, 2026, to the Farié-Téra axis, in the Tillabéri region. On the agenda, the monitoring of the rehabilitation work of this road and the evaluation of a crossing structure built in Garbougna to end the seasonal isolation of this locality . Through these two stages, the Minister took stock of the achievements, the remaining work and the measures taken to continue the work in a difficult security context.

article_manifest.original_title: Situation sécuritaire par la DIRPA : Six mois de reconquête passés à la loupe
article_manifest.summary: In the theatre of operations, war obeys an implacable temporality, made up of tactical silences, logistical requirements and planned flashes. From April 25 to October 20, 2026, the Malian strategic arc went through one of the densest sequences in its modern history . Within the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Colonel-Major Bakary Bocar Maiga drew up before the national and international press, on Friday, October 23, 2026, the operational balance sheet of a reconquest carried out on all fronts, balance sheets finalized on October 20, 2026 .
